Let \(R\) be the region bounded by the \(x\)-axis, the graph of \(y=\sqrt{x}\), and the line \(x=4\).
(a) Find the area of the region \(R\).
(b) Find the value of \(h\) such that the vertical line \(x=h\) divides the region \(R\) into two regions
of equal area.
(c) Find the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is revolved about the \(x\)-axis.
(d) The vertical line \(x=k\) divides the region \(R\) into two regions such that when these two
regions are revolved about the \(x\)-axis, they generate solids with equal volumes. Find the
value of \(k\).

1. Let \(R\) be the region bounded by the \(x\)-axis, the graph of \(y=\sqrt{x}\), and the line \(x=4\).
\begin{itemize}
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the area of the region \(R\).
\item[(b)] Find the value of \(h\) such that the vertical line \(x=h\) divides the region \(R\) into two regions of equal area.
\item[(c)] Find the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is revolved about the \(x\)-axis.
\item[(d)] The vertical line \(x=k\) divides the region \(R\) into two regions such that when these two regions are revolved about the \(x\)-axis, they generate solids with equal volumes. Find the value of \(k\).
\end{itemize}
\item[(a)]
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/4acd5a4d-23ad-4458-9886-7e67dd2aca8b-1.jpg?height=387&width=621&top_left_y=718&top_left_x=316)
\(A=\int_{0}^{4} \sqrt{x} d x=\left.\frac{2}{3} x^{3 / 2}\right|_{0} ^{4}=\frac{16}{3}\) or 5.333
\item[(b)] \(\int_{0}^{h} \sqrt{x} d x=\frac{8}{3} \underset{\text { or }-}{\int_{0}^{h} \sqrt{x}} d x=\int_{h}^{4} \sqrt{x} d x\)
\(\frac{2}{3} h^{3 / 2}=\frac{8}{3} \quad \frac{2}{3} h^{3 / 2}=\frac{16}{3}-\frac{2}{3} h^{3 / 2}\)
\(h=\sqrt[3]{16}\) or 2.520 or 2.519
\item[(c)] \(V=\pi \int_{0}^{4}(\sqrt{x})^{2} d x=\left.\pi \frac{x^{2}}{2}\right|_{0} ^{4}=8 \pi\)
or 25.133 or 25.132
\item[(d)]
\[
\begin{array}{l:l}
\pi \int_{0}^{k}(\sqrt{x})^{2} d x=4 \pi & \pi \int_{0}^{k}(\sqrt{x})^{2} d x=\pi \int_{k}^{4}(\sqrt{x})^{2} d x \\
\pi \frac{k^{2}}{2}=4 \pi & \pi \frac{k^{2}}{2}=8 \pi-\pi \frac{k^{2}}{2} \\
k=\sqrt{8} \text { or } 2.828
\end{array}
\]
\end{itemize}
